cases.name: Tiffany Foster
cases.about:
Her family says she’s a devoted mother who had recently gotten engaged. They added that it wasn’t like Tiffany to miss work or class at Georgia Military College, where she had been studying criminal justice.

https://www.nbcnews.com/dateline/missing-in-america/loved-ones-missing-georgia-mother-tiffany-foster-plead-help-desperate-n1281810?icid=recommended
cases.narrative: She is only missing at this point, but family said she is a mother of 3 and would not just leave. She failed to show up for work or her college class. On March 8, her car was found in College Park, Georgia with her purse and credit cards inside. She also failed to show up for a prepaid flight on 3/11/2021.
